media.title: Blüthner-Saal entrance, Lützowstraße 76, Berlin, 1912
media.description: Historical view of the entrance and street façade of the Blüthner-Saal and Klindworth-Scharwenka-Saal complex at Lützowstraße 76. The Blüthner-Saal was renamed Bach-Saal in 1927.
media.altText: Black-and-white 1912 street photograph of the ornate façade and entrance to the Blüthner-Saal at Lützowstraße 76 in Berlin, with signs for Blüthner pianos and Oskar Schwalm’s Piano-Magazin.
media.publicCaption: Entrance to the Blüthner-Saal at Lützowstraße 76, Berlin, 1912. The venue was renamed Bach-Saal in 1927.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer; reproduced from Oskar Schwalm’s Piano-Magazin via Grammophon und Schellackplatten Portal 78rpm.
media.rightsNote: Public-domain historical photograph: the image was published in 1912 and no photographer is identified. The local file is a faithful, reduced-size reproduction used to document the venue.

places.authorizedName: Bach-Saal / former Blüthner-Saal, Lützowstraße 76 / Genthiner Straße 11 (today Genthiner Straße 26), Berlin-Tiergarten
places.publicNote: Berlin concert venue where Róża Etkin gave a recital on 3 December 1927 that included the first performance of a work by B. Kaper. The venue is identifiable with the former Blüthner-Saal, renamed Bach-Saal after renovation in autumn 1927, in the Klindworth-Scharwenka / Schwalm hall complex at Lützowstraße 76 / Genthiner Straße.
